claims.statement: Three eigenvalues of magnitude at least 1 do not imply the existence of any fixed-size original-coordinate principal block with a dimension-free positive lower bound on its operator norm or quadratic coefficients.
claims.construction: Rank-three Walsh projections A_n=sum_{j=1}^3 r_j r_j^T with spectrum (1,1,1,0,...) and |(A_n)_{xy}|<=3/n, hence every k x k principal block has operator norm <=3k/n.
claims.scope: Refutes a structural bridge mechanism only, not the bounded-density conjecture.

claims.statement: For independent Z1,Z2 with density caps K1,K2 and a definite 2x2 quadratic block B, arbitrary linear perturbations have output density sup norm at most pi K1 K2 / sqrt(|det B|).
For the delocalized rank-three Walsh projection family A_n and arbitrary independent input densities bounded by 1, X^T A_n X has density sup norm at most 2 sqrt(2) pi, uniformly in n.
dependencies: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov one-dimensional marginal density bound sqrt(2) for product densities

claims.statement: For an arbitrary three-dimensional spectral subspace, find a product-preserving high-cardinality aggregation/partition or equivalent nonlinear inequality yielding a dimension-free L1-frequency or small-ball bound; it must cover delocalized row frames without fixed-size block extraction.

peer_sources.applied_scope: Sharper C=pi coordinate-diagonal theorem and exact failure of law-uniform pointwise Fresnel decay.
Non-diagonal hyperbolic-pair-plus-square conditional block theorem and product-preserving block-extraction proposal stress-tested by Walsh family.

external_source.title: On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures
external_source.authors: Galyna Livshyts, Grigoris Paouris, Peter Pivovarov
external_source.used_scope: Only k=1 marginal density bound sqrt(2) for product densities with factor density caps 1.
